result.topic_en: Euler shows that products of residues of powers of a modulo a prime P are again residues in the series, that any residue can be obtained from another by multiplication by a residue, and begins discussing the unit residue and the residue corresponding to each residue.
result.transcription:
92 RESIDVA EX DIVIS. POTESTATVM
ſequens igitur poteſtas $a^r$ vnitatem pro reſiduo habebit, eritque forma $a^r-1$ per diuiſorem P diuiſibilis. Quia vero $r$ eſt pars aliquota numeri $P-1$, illa forma $a^{P-1}-1$ per hanc $a^r-1$ erit diuiſibilis, ideoque etiam per ipſum diuiſorem P.
24. In ſerie reſiduorum $1, \alpha,  eta, \gamma, \delta$ etc. ſiue fuerit completa ſiue incompleta, ſimul producta ex binis, ternis quaternis etc. hincque etiam ſingulorum poteſtates quaecunque, ſiquidem per diuiſorem P deprimantur, occurrunt.
Dem. Si enim poteſtas $a^m$ reſiduum relinquat $\mu$, et poteſtas $a^n$ reſiduum $
u$, erit $a^m = ..P+\mu$ et $a^n = ..P+
u$ vbi duo puncta .. loco cuiusuis indicis integri ſcribo; hincque $a^{m+n} = ..P+\mu
u$, ita vt poteſtas $a^{m+n}$ reſiduum $\mu
u$ ſit relictura. Quare cum productum binorum quorumcunque reſiduorum in ſerie reſiduorum occurrat, propoſitum eſt manifeſtum.
25. Datis duobus reſiduis $\mu$ et $
u$ in ſerie reſiduorum etiam aliquod reperietur $\omega$ vt ſit $
u=\mu\omega$ vel $
u=\mu\omega-..P$.
Dem. Oriantur enim reſidua $\mu$ et $
u$ a poteſtatibus $a^m$ et $a^n$ ac ſit $\omega$ reſiduum a poteſtate $a^{n-m}$ vel hac $a^{P-1+n-m}$ ſi forte fuerit $n<m$, eritque poteſtatis $a^n=a^m.a^{n-m}$ reſiduum $=\mu\omega-..P$ ideoque $
u=\mu\omega-..P$.
26. Cum vnitas ſemper in ſerie reſiduorum contineatur, cuique reſiduo $\mu$ reſpondebit ibidem aliud

items.quote: In ſerie reſiduorum $1, \alpha, \beta, \gamma, \delta$ etc. ſiue fuerit completa ſiue incompleta, ſimul producta ex binis, ternis quaternis etc. hincque etiam ſingulorum poteſtates quaecunque, ſiquidem per diuiſorem P deprimantur, occurrunt.
items.english: In the series of residues 1, α, β, γ, δ etc., whether it be complete or incomplete, the products of any two, three, four etc., and hence also any powers of the individual residues, provided they are reduced by the divisor P, also occur.

items.quote:
Datis duobus reſiduis $\mu$ et $
u$ in ſerie reſiduorum etiam aliquod reperietur $\omega$ vt ſit $
u=\mu\omega$ vel $
u=\mu\omega-..P$.
items.english: Given two residues μ and ν, some residue ω will also be found in the series of residues such that ν = μω or ν = μω − (a multiple of) P.

items.quote: Cum vnitas ſemper in ſerie reſiduorum contineatur, cuique reſiduo $\mu$ reſpondebit ibidem aliud
items.english: Since unity is always contained in the series of residues, to each residue μ there will correspond in the same series another (residue)...
